title: stalkReward casts a potentially-negative int96 stem delta to uint96 (huge value) with no enforced endStem >= startStem
description: LibSilo.stalkReward computes `uint128(uint96(endStem.sub(startStem))).mul(bdv).div(PRECISION)`. The NatSpec states 'endStem must be larger than startStem' but the code does NOT enforce it. If a caller passed endStem < startStem, the int96 difference is negative and `uint96(negative)` becomes a ~7.9e28-scale value, then `.mul(bdv)` (LibRedundantMath128, checked) overflows uint128 and reverts for any non-trivial bdv. In practice every caller derives startStem from a stored deposit stem and endStem from the current stemTip / germStem.stemTip, and stemTipForToken only grows over time, so startStem <= endStem holds for valid deposits; removeDepositFromAccount / grownStalkForDeposit additionally require stem <= stemTip. Therefore the path is a checked-revert (DoS) at worst and is not attacker-reachable with the invariant intact. Flagged as a robustness gap: an explicit `require(endStem >= startStem)` would replace a silent giant-cast-then-overflow with a clear error.
impact: No value extraction; a malformed (endStem < startStem) call reverts via checked uint128 multiplication rather than returning a wrong reward. Truncation of the final `reward` to uint128 is also safe: (stemDelta * bdv)/1e6 fits uint128 for any realistic Bean BDV. Info.

ite.intent: Obtain an inflated grown-stalk reward by inverting stem order
ite.technique: Pass endStem < startStem so uint96 cast yields a huge multiplier
ite.evasion: stem ordering is enforced upstream (stem <= stemTip) for every caller; checked mul reverts otherwise

ice_chain.impact: Inflated stalk would be minted IF an inverted-stem call were reachable; it is not (checked overflow reverts and upstream guards hold)

648:     //////////////////////// UTILITIES ////////////////////////

650:     /**
651:      * @notice Calculates the Stalk reward based on the start and end
652:      * stems, and the amount of BDV deposited. Stems represent the
653:      * amount of grown stalk per BDV, so the difference between the
654:      * start index and end index (stem) multiplied by the amount of
655:      * bdv deposited will give the amount of stalk earned.
656:      * formula: stalk = bdv * (ΔstalkPerBdv)
657:      *
658:      * @dev endStem must be larger than startStem.
659:      *
660:      */
661:     function stalkReward(
662:         int96 startStem,
663:         int96 endStem,
664:         uint128 bdv
665:     ) internal pure returns (uint256) {
666:         uint128 reward = uint128(uint96(endStem.sub(startStem))).mul(bdv).div(PRECISION);
667: 
668:         return reward;
669:     }

671:     /**
672:      * @dev Internal function to compute `account` balance of Earned Beans.
673:      *
674:      * The number of Earned Beans is equal to the difference between:
675:      *  - the "expected" Stalk balance, determined from the account balance of
676:      *    Roots.
677:      *  - the "account" Stalk balance, stored in account storage.
678:      * divided by the number of Stalk per Bean.
679:      * The earned beans from the latest season
680:      */
681:     function _balanceOfEarnedBeans(
682:         uint256 accountStalk,
683:         uint256 accountRoots
684:     ) internal view returns (uint256 beans) {
685:         AppStorage storage s = LibAppStorage.diamondStorage();
686:         // There will be no Roots before the first Deposit is made.
687:         if (s.sys.silo.roots == 0) return 0;
688: 
689:         uint256 stalk = s.sys.silo.stalk.mul(accountRoots).div(s.sys.silo.roots);
690: 
691:         // Beanstalk rounds down when minting Roots. Thus, it is possible that
692:         // balanceOfRoots / totalRoots * totalStalk < s.accts[account].stalk.
693:         // As `account` Earned Balance balance should never be negative,
694:         // Beanstalk returns 0 instead.
695:         if (stalk <= accountStalk) return 0;
696: 
697:         // Calculate Earned Stalk and convert to Earned Beans.
698:         beans = (stalk - accountStalk).div(C.STALK_PER_BEAN);
699:         if (beans > s.sys.silo.earnedBeans) return s.sys.silo.earnedBeans;
